findings.evidence: Basic.lean:64-70 vs :74-82; grep `extendByZero_apply` → single hit at Basic.lean:68.
findings.fix: Delete `extendByZero_apply`. (Keep `twoSpeciesFrag_def` and `powerFrag_apply`: `MomentumSumRule.lean` is `public section` without `@[expose]`, so those two public defs do need an unfolding lemma.)
findings.issue: `extendByZero_apply` restates the body of `extendByZero` (Basic.lean:64) up to `rfl` and is used nowhere in the PR (grep for `extendByZero_apply` returns only its own definition). The file is under `@[expose] public section` (Basic.lean:18), so downstream users can already `rw [extendByZero]`/`simp [extendByZero]`, and the two cases are covered by `extendByZero_of_mem` (:74) and `extendByZero_of_notMem` (:80), which are themselves `Set.indicator_of_mem`/`indicator_of_notMem` applied.

findings.evidence: MomentumSumRule.lean:120-135 and :218-222 share the rewrite chain `zMoment_extendByZero, zMoment_eq_intervalIntegral` followed by `simp only [..., intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow]`.
findings.fix: Factor one lemma, e.g. `zMoment_extendByZero_monomial (c : ℝ) (m k : ℕ) : zMoment (extendByZero fun _ _ z _ => c * z ^ m) k h i Q2 = c / (k + m + 1)`, proved once from `zMoment_extendByZero`, `zMoment_eq_intervalIntegral`, `intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul` and `integral_pow`. Then `zMoment_powerFrag` is the `c = n + 2, m = n` case, species 0 of `twoSpeciesFrag` is `c = 2, m = 1`, and species 1 is the difference of the `m = 0` and `m = 1` cases.
findings.issue: `zMoment_one_twoSpeciesFrag` re-derives, twice by hand (lines 122-135, including an `intervalIntegral.integral_sub` with two `Continuous.intervalIntegrable` side goals), the same `∫₀¹ zᵏ·(c·zⁿ)` computation that `zMoment_powerFrag` (:216) performs a third time with the identical tactic block `simp only [this, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow]`. The coefficient in `powerFrag` is locked to `n + 2`, which is the only reason the existing lemma does not apply.

summary: No existing Mathlib or EpsilonEridani declaration is duplicated: the PDF-side momentum sum rule sums over flavours of a `Pdf`, not species of a `Frag`, and `extendByZero` has no upstream counterpart. Two residual duplications inside the diff: an unused `rfl` restatement of `extendByZero`, and three hand-rolled copies of the same monomial-moment integral computation.
